channel.description: Auto-updating cheatsheet for Claude Code — keyboard shortcuts, commands, tips, and more.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.206 highlights
item.description:
• /cd now shows directory path suggestions like /add-dir (v2.1.206)
  • /doctor can suggest trimming CLAUDE.md of derivable content (v2.1.206)
  • /commit-push-pr auto-allows git push to configured remote (v2.1.206)
  • /login supports Anthropic public gateway endpoints (v2.1.206)
  • EnterWorktree confirms before entering worktree outside project dir (v2.1.206)
  • Agents view: Ctrl+X permanently removes completed sessions (v2.1.206)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.206
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

~ [slash-commands] /cd [path]: Move session to new working directory with path suggestions; no prompt cache break
~ [slash-commands] /doctor: Setup checkup: diagnose/fix issues; suggest CLAUDE.md trim (/checkup alias)
~ [workflows-tips] EnterWorktree (switch): Switch between Claude-managed worktrees; confirms if outside project dir
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] Ctrl+X Ctrl+K: Kill background agents; agents view: permanently remove completed session

Full changelog

• Added directory path suggestions to `/cd`, matching `/add-dir` behavior
• Added a `/doctor` check that proposes trimming checked-in `CLAUDE.md` files by cutting content Claude could derive from the codebase
• `/commit-push-pr` now auto-allows `git push` to the repo's configured push remote (`remote.pushDefault`, or the sole remote when only one is configured) in addition to `origin`
• Gateway: `/login` now supports Anthropic-operated public gateway endpoints
• `EnterWorktree` now asks for confirmation before entering a git worktree outside the project's `.claude/worktrees/` directory
• Background agents now upgrade to a new version in the background right after a Claude Code update, instead of paying a slow stale-session upgrade when you attach
• Fixed an expired login failing every model with a misleading "There's an issue with the selected model" error instead of prompting to run `/login`
• Fixed `claude --resume` and `--continue` not responding to keyboard input on startup
• Fixed MCP servers configured via `--mcp-config` or `.mcp.json` ignoring a per-server `request_timeout_ms`, which caused long-running MCP tool calls to time out at the 60s default in fresh sessions
• Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_BODY` being silently ignored by `claude agents` / `--bg` background workers; the shell-exported override now follows the dispatching session
• Fixed OAuth MCP servers requiring manual re-authentication after a single failed token refresh
• Fixed `--permission-prompt-tool` pointing at an MCP server crashing with "MCP tool not found" on cold start before the server finishes connecting
• Fixed `/model` picker rows printing a price for a different model than the row named, and stopped quoting first-party list prices on providers that don't bill them
• Fixed server-provided model rows being misplaced in the `/model` picker when an entitlement or allowlist restriction drops the row they were positioned against
• Fixed desktop sessions getting stuck showing "running" after a slash command was sent mid-turn
• Fixed keyboard input being ignored in the agents view when a setup prompt appeared before a bare `claude --resume` on Windows
• Fixed `claude rm` leaving the removed job in the daemon roster, causing the row to reappear in `claude agents`
• Fixed `/remote-control` showing "Unknown command" when logged out — it now explains how to sign in
• Fixed left arrow not stepping back out of a phase or agent in the workflow detail view
• Fixed `/status` listing the same broken-install warning twice
• Fixed false "disused plugin" tips and skewed disuse telemetry for LSP plugins
• Fixed `/doctor`'s update check to compare Homebrew installs against their cask's channel instead of the settings channel
• Fixed the fullscreen jump-to-bottom pill suggesting Ctrl+End on macOS, not showing rebound chords, and wrapping over the transcript
• Bedrock: fixed a multi-minute startup hang when using an `awsCredentialExport` helper on networks with restricted egress
• Improved `/code-review` findings quality on claude-opus-4-8 across all effort levels
• Improved agents view: status column now uses full terminal width instead of truncating at 64 characters
• Changed agents view: Ctrl+X now permanently removes a completed session, and sessions no longer render twice; deleted background jobs stay deleted

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.199
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [skills-agents] Stacked invocation: Chain up to 5 skills: /skill-a /skill-b do XYZ
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG: 300 retries for transient errors; lifts MAX_RETRIES cap of 15

- [skills-agents] root SKILL.md
- [config-env] sandbox.allowAppleEvents
- [config-env] OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES

~ [config-env] Notification: When Claude sends notification; agent_needs_input / agent_completed from bg agents

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.196
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG: Set 0 to disable; 5-min idle abort+retry on by default for all providers
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] ←: Open agents view
~ [slash-commands] /model [model]: Switch model; Org/Role default when admin sets one (←→ effort, s = session only)
~ [workflows-tips] API key → no cloud: API key / non-Anthropic ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL disables RC, /schedule, MCP, notifications
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.195
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS: Disable mouse click/drag/hover in fullscreen mode; wheel scroll still works
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_SHELL_PRESSURE_REAP

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.193
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] autoMode.classifyAllShell: Route all Bash/PowerShell commands through auto-mode classifier
+ [config-env] OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES: 1=log assistant responses in OTEL; 0=keep prompts-only; unset follows OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_SHELL_PRESSURE_REAP: Set to 1 to disable automatic memory-pressure reaping of idle bg shells
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] !: Direct bash; file path autocomplete; Claude responds to output
- [config-env] teammateMode: "iterm2"
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_TOOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.191
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

~ [slash-commands] /rewind: Rewind conv / code checkpoint; resume from before /clear (/undo alias)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.187
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] sandbox.credentials: Block sandboxed commands from reading credential files and secret env vars
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_TOOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT: Override 5-min idle timeout for remote MCP tool calls
~ [config-env] ANTHROPIC_MODEL: Default model; org restrictions can override
~ [slash-commands] /btw <question>: Side question (no context); ←/→ step through earlier answers
- [config-env] awsAuthRefresh
- [config-env] attribution.sessionUrl

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.186
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [mcp-servers] claude mcp login <name>: Authenticate MCP server from CLI; --no-browser for SSH
+ [mcp-servers] claude mcp logout <name>: Revoke MCP server authentication from CLI
+ [config-env] teammateMode: "iterm2": Use iTerm2 backend for agent teams; warns if it2 CLI missing
+ [config-env] respondToBashCommands: false keeps ! bash output as context only (default: Claude responds)
+ [config-env] awsAuthRefresh: Adds AWS credential refresh option to /login (managed)
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES: Max API retries (caps at 15); use RETRY_WATCHDOG for unattended
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG: Alternative retry cap for unattended/headless sessions
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] !: Direct bash; Claude responds to output (respondToBashCommands: false disables)
~ [slash-commands] /workflows: View dynamic workflow runs; press f to filter status
- [config-env] language
- [config-env] enforceAvailableModels
- [config-env] allowManagedHooksOnly
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE
